objective: Prepare a bounded Michel OS release-provenance improvement for isolated implementation, exact-candidate verification and approval-gated production deployment.
outcome: Michel OS can report its exact deployed Git candidate through a non-secret readiness response, while retaining the existing health check, rollback workflow and production data.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A future isolated candidate exposes an immutable 40-hex release SHA in the existing readiness response without exposing secrets or environment values.
The readiness route continues to verify PostgreSQL connectivity and returns a non-ready response when the database is unavailable.
The deployment path binds the reported release SHA, deployed-sha stamp and exact approved candidate to the same commit.
The future change introduces no database migration, preserves the current production revision for rollback and is not deployed without a verified Quality Gate receipt and Cristian approval.
